# Winston AI

Winston AI provides a comprehensive content verification and management platform, offering tools for AI-generated text detection, plagiarism detection, and AI image detection.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/winston-ai/.

## Actions

- **AI Text Detection** (read-only): Detect ai-generated text.
- **Plagiarism Detection** (read-only): Detect plagiarism.
- **TEXT_COMPARE** (read-only): Compare two texts.
